item.title: Coordinated routing improves travel times and cuts emissions
item.content:encoded:
Nature Cities, Published online: 08 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44284-026-00539-4

This study presents large-scale experimental evidence that redirecting a small number of trips can improve overall traffic flow. We demonstrate that rerouting <2% of trips can measurably increase driving speeds and potentially save hundreds to thousands of tonnes of CO2 emissions per city each year.
